articles_publicada_com_resumo.name: articles_publicada_com_resumo
articles_publicada_com_resumo.value: "articles"."status" <> 'publicado' OR ("articles"."resumo" IS NOT NULL AND length("articles"."resumo") BETWEEN 1 AND 300)

budget_reservations_conciliada.name: budget_reservations_conciliada
budget_reservations_conciliada.value: "budget_reservations"."state" <> 'conciliada' OR ("budget_reservations"."actual_microusd" IS NOT NULL AND "budget_reservations"."generation_id" IS NOT NULL)

article_revisions_aprovada_com_recibo.name: article_revisions_aprovada_com_recibo
article_revisions_aprovada_com_recibo.value: "article_revisions"."estado" NOT IN ('aprovada', 'publicada') OR ("article_revisions"."receipt_id" IS NOT NULL AND "article_revisions"."conteudo_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

media_arquivo_completo.name: media_arquivo_completo
media_arquivo_completo.value: "media"."blob_key" IS NULL OR ("media"."mime" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."bytes" > 0)

ad_creatives_arquivo_coerente.name: ad_creatives_arquivo_coerente
ad_creatives_arquivo_coerente.value: ("ad_creatives"."arquivo_mime" IS NULL AND "ad_creatives"."largura" IS NULL AND "ad_creatives"."altura" IS NULL AND "ad_creatives"."tamanho_kb" IS NULL AND "ad_creatives"."arquivo_sha256" IS NULL) OR ("ad_creatives"."arquivo_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "ad_creatives"."arquivo_mime" IN ('image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif') AND "ad_creatives"."largura" > 0 AND "ad_creatives"."altura" > 0 AND "ad_creatives"."tamanho_kb" > 0 AND "ad_creatives"."arquivo_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

ad_creatives_aprovado_completo.name: ad_creatives_aprovado_completo
ad_creatives_aprovado_completo.value: NOT "ad_creatives"."aprovado" OR ("ad_creatives"."arquivo_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "ad_creatives"."arquivo_mime" IS NOT NULL AND "ad_creatives"."largura" IS NOT NULL AND "ad_creatives"."altura" IS NOT NULL AND "ad_creatives"."tamanho_kb" IS NOT NULL AND "ad_creatives"."arquivo_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "ad_creatives"."texto_alternativo" IS NOT NULL AND "ad_creatives"."destino_url" IS NOT NULL)

ad_formats_preco_coerente.name: ad_formats_preco_coerente
ad_formats_preco_coerente.value: ("ad_formats"."preco_tipo" = 'verba_mais_taxa' AND "ad_formats"."preco_valor_brl" IS NULL AND "ad_formats"."taxa_pct" IS NOT NULL) OR ("ad_formats"."preco_tipo" <> 'verba_mais_taxa' AND "ad_formats"."preco_valor_brl" IS NOT NULL AND "ad_formats"."preco_valor_brl" >= 0)

ad_slots_reservavel_completo.name: ad_slots_reservavel_completo
ad_slots_reservavel_completo.value: "ad_slots"."limite_cotas" IS NULL OR "ad_slots"."contrato_minimo_dias" IS NOT NULL

commercial_metrics_disponivel_completa.name: commercial_metrics_disponivel_completa
commercial_metrics_disponivel_completa.value: "commercial_metrics"."status" = 'unavailable' OR ("commercial_metrics"."valor" IS NOT NULL AND "commercial_metrics"."periodo_inicio" IS NOT NULL AND "commercial_metrics"."periodo_fim" IS NOT NULL AND "commercial_metrics"."coletado_em" IS NOT NULL AND "commercial_metrics"."periodo_fim" >= "commercial_metrics"."periodo_inicio")

action_items_done_evidence_ck.name: action_items_done_evidence_ck
action_items_done_evidence_ck.value: "action_items"."status" <> 'done' OR ("action_items"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "action_items"."evidence_ref" IS NOT NULL)

meeting_runs_reschedule_ck.name: meeting_runs_reschedule_ck
meeting_runs_reschedule_ck.value: ("meeting_runs"."rescheduled_date" IS NULL AND "meeting_runs"."reschedule_reason" IS NULL) OR ("meeting_runs"."rescheduled_date" IS NOT NULL AND "meeting_runs"."rescheduled_date" > "meeting_runs"."local_date" AND "meeting_runs"."reschedule_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "meeting_runs"."reschedule_reason" = 'holiday_move')

meeting_runs_reason_status_ck.name: meeting_runs_reason_status_ck
meeting_runs_reason_status_ck.value: ("meeting_runs"."status" = 'status_only' AND "meeting_runs"."reason" IS NOT NULL) OR ("meeting_runs"."status" <> 'status_only' AND "meeting_runs"."reason" IS NULL)

site_documentos_versao.name: site_documentos_versao
site_documentos_versao.value: ("site_documentos"."estado" = 'rascunho' AND "site_documentos"."versao" IS NULL) OR ("site_documentos"."estado" <> 'rascunho' AND "site_documentos"."versao" IS NOT NULL AND "site_documentos"."versao" > 0)

site_documentos_publicado.name: site_documentos_publicado
site_documentos_publicado.value: "site_documentos"."estado" NOT IN ('publicado', 'substituido') OR "site_documentos"."publicado_em" IS NOT NULL

openbot_cost_nonneg.name: openbot_cost_nonneg
openbot_cost_nonneg.value: "openbot_cost_entries"."cost_micro" >= 0 AND ("openbot_cost_entries"."prompt_tokens" IS NULL OR "openbot_cost_entries"."prompt_tokens" >= 0) AND ("openbot_cost_entries"."completion_tokens" IS NULL OR "openbot_cost_entries"."completion_tokens" >= 0) AND ("openbot_cost_entries"."cache_read_tokens" IS NULL OR "openbot_cost_entries"."cache_read_tokens" >= 0) AND ("openbot_cost_entries"."cache_write_tokens" IS NULL OR "openbot_cost_entries"."cache_write_tokens" >= 0)

openbot_tasks_route.name: openbot_tasks_route
openbot_tasks_route.value: jsonb_typeof("openbot_tasks"."route") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("openbot_tasks"."route") BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND "openbot_tasks"."route_index" >= 0 AND "openbot_tasks"."route_index" < jsonb_array_length("openbot_tasks"."route")

openbot_tasks_lease.name: openbot_tasks_lease
openbot_tasks_lease.value: "openbot_tasks"."status" <> 'leased' OR ("openbot_tasks"."lease_id" IS NOT NULL AND "openbot_tasks"."lease_holder" IS NOT NULL AND "openbot_tasks"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

creative_cards_revisado.name: creative_cards_revisado
creative_cards_revisado.value: "creative_cards"."estado" NOT IN ('aprovado', 'rejeitado') OR ("creative_cards"."revisado_por" IS NOT NULL AND "creative_cards"."revisado_em" IS NOT NULL)
